messages:
maria: Quick check — we need to lock RFC review slots for Thursday. Authors: @anya (diff-system), @lee (kv-cache), @sam (quant). Who can take reviewer slots and any ordering preferences? Also pre-read reminders going out. @here please reply with availability.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Thu 10:00–11:00 PT (RFC reviews). RSVP still open.
jon: I can review — happy to take the first slot (10:00) and cover @anya's RFC. Prefer order: anya -> lee -> sam, 20m per RFC + 5m buffer.
sam: I can do last slot. If @lee needs the middle because of an overlap, I can swap. Also can authors post a 1-paragraph TL;DR in the PR? Saves time.
anya: TL;DR posted in PR: https://git/repo/pull/123 — short summary and risk section. I also added a few notes under "Design decisions".
maria: Thanks @anya. Can someone lead the pre-read 2-min recap for each RFC? Jon — you good for @anya? Lee — can you do yours? Sam will self-serve?
jon: Yep happy to do @anya recap.
lee: I have an overlapping stand at 10:30 PT — I'd prefer the middle slot (10:20) rather than last. If @sam can take last, that works.
sam: I can take last, no problem. Swapping with @lee sounds fine.
maria: Great — provisional order: 1) @anya (jon reviewing) 2) @lee (self-review + 2nd reviewer?) 3) @sam (self). We should aim for two reviewers where possible. Any volunteer to be second reviewer for Lee?
jon: I can be a second reviewer for Lee if needed — I can skim the diff beforehand.
anya: I'll also paste a mini checklist in the PR for reviewers.
maria: Pls follow this pre-read checklist before the meeting:
```
Pre-read checklist:
- Read TL;DR (1–2 mins)
- Scan top-level diff and top 2 changed files
- Leave "blocking" comment if something must change before merge
- Add one-line takeaway in this thread (e.g., +approve / needs-changes)
```
calendar-bot: Agenda doc: https://docs.internal/rfcs/review-thu (owners: maria).
lee: Confirmed — middle slot for me. I'll post a short 3-slide summary to the doc by EOD.
jon: I'll aim to leave my reviews before the meeting if possible.
maria: Perfect. I'll update the calendar title to "RFC reviews — order: Anya / Lee / Sam" and ping authors with pre-read reminder at EOD. If anything changes, reply here, otherwise I'll finalize at 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
sam: One more ask — can we set the meeting to auto-record notes to the agenda doc? Saves duplication.
maria: Good idea — enabling notes recording and assigning note-taker to @jon for first two items.
anya: Thanks everyone. See you Thursday.
jon: see you — will add my one-line takeaway after my pre-read. :white_check_mark:
